hero.eyebrow: Allergy, asthma & immunology in North Augusta
hero.title: Enjoy the outdoors *without the headaches*
hero.lede: Excellent, compassionate allergy, asthma and immunology care for the whole family, since 2008. Skin testing designed not to hurt, lung-function testing, and allergy shots, with the goal of treating you like family as we help you get better.

image.alt: A family walking hand in hand along a boardwalk through tall grass

facts.label: Skin testing designed not to hurt

items.title: Asthma & lungs
items.text: Asthma and pulmonary (lung) conditions, with lung-function testing to guide treatment.

items.title: Seasonal & pet allergies
items.text: Pollen, mold, dust mites and pets: find out exactly what sets you off.

items.title: Food & gut allergies
items.text: Food allergies, gut allergies and anaphylaxis, diagnosed carefully.

items.title: Skin conditions
items.text: Eczema, hives and other allergic skin conditions.

items.title: Sinus, ear, nose & throat
items.text: Sinus trouble and ear, nose and throat symptoms, plus eye allergies.

items.title: Immune dysfunction
items.text: Evaluation of immune problems. Something else? Call and ask: we treat all kinds of allergies.

items.title: History and exam
items.text: In-depth questions and a thorough exam at every new-patient visit, looking for every clue and trigger.

items.title: Allergy skin testing
items.text: Pollens, molds, animals, mites, cockroaches and foods, plus fire ants, honeybees, yellow jackets, wasps and hornets. Designed not to hurt, break the skin or bleed.

items.title: Lung-function testing
items.text: Computer-based spirometry measures how your lungs work, to diagnose and manage asthma.

items.title: Allergy shots
items.text: Regular shots during our shot hours, listed below.

sections.title: Meet *the team*

image.alt: The Covenant Family Allergy team standing together outside the office

body: Dr. Matthew Clark founded Covenant Family Allergy in 2008. A former US Navy doctor and flight surgeon, he completed a pediatrics residency and an allergy, asthma and immunology fellowship at MCG, and is board certified in Pediatrics and in Allergy, Asthma and Immunology.
Curtis Wright, PA, earned his physician assistant degree at MUSC and is NCCPA board certified. After nine years in family practice in Batesburg-Leesville and Edgefield, he joined Dr. Clark in 2015.
list: Dr. Matthew Clark: board certified in Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
Curtis Wright, PA: NCCPA board certified
Allergy care for children and adults

items.a: No. Shot hours are listed above, and closures are posted on our Facebook page. Call (803) 279-7666 for appointments.
Yes. Dr. Clark is board certified in Pediatrics as well as Allergy, Asthma and Immunology.
